rulings.ruling: Ruling: ambiguity; amb.2025.f1116_ratio_places (i1116 p. 18, Line 3f, "round off the result to at least four decimal places"; p. 25, Line 19, no rounding stated). The project rounds line 19 half-up to four places (chosen reading, coordinator delegation D6); the model kept six places (3,426.70 / 94,250 = 0.036358; 0.0364 at four places). The readings differ by cents ($549.46 v. $548.82); every later line repeats the same difference. Model value dropped.

Ruling: model error; Form 1116 (2025) line 3a, certain itemized deductions or standard deduction, from the case's given Schedule A amounts (line 4 $0, line 5e $8,000: project $8,000.00). The model did not read line 3a from the given amounts; it back-solved $26,000 from line 6 ($917.80 / 0.0353), treating all of line 6 as line 3g, although line 6 also adds lines 2, 4a, 4b and 5 (the case's apportioned home mortgage interest is on line 4a). Both sides agree on line 6. Model value dropped.

Ruling: model error; Form 1116 (2025) line 3c (line 3a plus 3b), certain itemized deductions or standard deduction, from the case's given Schedule A amounts (line 4 $0, line 5e $8,000: project $8,000.00).
